summary: SmartDomo Matterport POI Integration testing completed. All backend APIs working correctly. Frontend POI selector in Apparati form and Vista 3D POI list both functional. Fixed critical bug in elettrodomestici creation where user_id was not being set from session token.

minor.issue: Returns 520 error when SmartThings token expired - known issue from previous iteration

integration_issues.issue: Console warning: 'mpSdk.Tag.data.collect is not a function' - using fallback Mattertag.getData which works correctly

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Bug in POST /api/elettrodomestici - user_id was not being set from session token. Changed line 1560 to pass user_id explicitly: Elettrodomestico(**validated_data.model_dump(), user_id=user['id'])
POI selector in ElettrodomesticoForm.js correctly uses poi.id as value for matterport_tag_id field
Backend endpoint /api/elettrodomestici/by-poi/{poi_id} correctly searches by matterport_tag_id field
MatterportManager.js loadLinkedApparato function correctly calls by-poi endpoint with selectedPoi.id

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Login, Apparati tab, Smart tab POI selector, Vista 3D POI list all working)

seed_data_creation: None - used existing data. 7 POIs available, 11 elettrodomestici
context_for_next_testing_agent: Matterport POI integration feature fully tested and working. Admin and Geasar logins both work. POI selector in Apparati form Smart tab shows all available POIs. Vista 3D tab shows POI list in sidebar with navigation. Backend by-poi endpoint returns linked elettrodomestico correctly after fix. SmartThings integration returns 520 errors (token expired) but this is a known issue.

features_tested.smart_tab_poi_selector: PASS - Shows dropdown with 7 POIs from backend
features_tested.poi_navigation: PASS - Clicking POI navigates 3D view to location

bug_fixed.description: POST /api/elettrodomestici was not setting user_id from session token
bug_fixed.root_cause: ElettrodomesticoCreate model doesn't include user_id field, so when creating Elettrodomestico from validated_data.model_dump(), the user_id defaulted to DEFAULT_USER_ID instead of the authenticated user's ID
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Changed line 1560 in server.py to explicitly pass user_id: Elettrodomestico(**validated_data.model_dump(), user_id=user['id'])
bug_fixed.impact: Without this fix, elettrodomestici created by authenticated users would have wrong user_id, causing by-poi endpoint to not find them when filtering by user_id
